classification.difficultyReason: Students reverse each conditional and independently judge both directions. The rectangle statement requires recognising that one side does not determine area and that a fixed area does not force a particular side length.

content.prompt: State whether each statement below is true or false, then write down its converse. Then state whether the converse is true or false.

children.label: a
children.prompt: If you can run, then you can walk.

answer.short: True. Converse: If you can walk, then you can run. False.
answer.worked: The statement is true under the ordinary interpretation of these abilities. Reverse the condition and conclusion: If you can walk, then you can run. This converse is false: someone may be able to walk but unable to run.

children.label: b
children.prompt: If a number is greater than 10, then it is greater than 1000.

answer.short: False. Converse: If a number is greater than 1000, then it is greater than 10. True.
answer.worked: The statement is false: $20>10$, but $20<1000$. Reverse the condition and conclusion: If a number is greater than 1000, then it is greater than 10. This converse is true because $1000>10$.

children.label: c
children.prompt: If a man lives in Australia, then he lives in Melbourne.

answer.short: False. Converse: If a man lives in Melbourne, then he lives in Australia. True.
answer.worked: The statement is false: a man living in Sydney lives in Australia but does not live in Melbourne. Reverse the condition and conclusion: If a man lives in Melbourne, then he lives in Australia. This converse is true because Melbourne is in Australia.

children.label: d
children.prompt: If a number is divisible by 5, then its last digit is 5.

answer.short: False. Converse: If the last digit of a number is 5, then it is divisible by 5. True.
answer.worked: The statement is false: $10$ is divisible by $5$, but its last digit is $0$. Reverse the condition and conclusion: If the last digit of a number is 5, then it is divisible by 5. This converse is true by the divisibility rule for $5$.

children.label: e
children.prompt: If a woman has a daughter, then she is a mother.

answer.short: True. Converse: If a woman is a mother, then she has a daughter. False.
answer.worked: The statement is true because a woman with a daughter has a child. Reverse the condition and conclusion: If a woman is a mother, then she has a daughter. This converse is false: a mother may have only sons.

children.label: f
children.prompt: If a whole number has fewer than four digits, then it is less than 1000.

answer.short: True. Converse: If a whole number is less than 1000, then it has fewer than four digits. True.
answer.worked: The statement is true: a whole number with fewer than four digits is at most $999$. Reverse the condition and conclusion: If a whole number is less than 1000, then it has fewer than four digits. This converse is also true: the whole numbers from $0$ to $999$ have at most three digits.

children.label: g
children.prompt: If a dog has black and white hair, then it can stand on its hind legs.

answer.short: False. Converse: If a dog can stand on its hind legs, then it has black and white hair. False.
answer.worked: The statement is false: black and white hair does not guarantee that a dog can stand on its hind legs. Reverse the condition and conclusion: If a dog can stand on its hind legs, then it has black and white hair. This converse is false: a dog with another hair colour may be able to stand on its hind legs.

children.label: h
children.prompt: If one side of a rectangle has length $8\text{ cm}$, then its area is $40\text{ cm}^2$.

answer.short: False. Converse: If the area of a rectangle is $40\text{ cm}^2$, then one of its sides has length $8\text{ cm}$. False.
answer.worked: The statement is false: a rectangle measuring $8\text{ cm}$ by $2\text{ cm}$ has area $16\text{ cm}^2$. Reverse the condition and conclusion: If the area of a rectangle is $40\text{ cm}^2$, then one of its sides has length $8\text{ cm}$. This converse is false: a rectangle measuring $4\text{ cm}$ by $10\text{ cm}$ has area $40\text{ cm}^2$, but neither side has length $8\text{ cm}$.
